# Requirements Document: Applying a payment outcome

## Introduction

What a payment's outcome does to the order items it covers.  A successful
payment moves their confirmed services to ready to proceed and removes their
payment time limits; a failed or pending payment changes nothing.

These requirements are generated from the Lean model in [`Rules/OneOrder/Payment/Outcome.lean`](https://github.com/samdengler/airline-order-verified/blob/main/Rules/OneOrder/Payment/Outcome.lean). Each acceptance criterion carries the status the build computed for it: *proven* means a theorem the build checked, *example only* means a computed example, *open* means a theorem the build could not prove, and *not checked* means no theorem or example covers it yet.

## Requirements

### Requirement ONE-305

**User Story:** As an airline, I want a successful payment to release the order items it paid for, so that their services can be delivered and are no longer at risk of removal.

**Rule:** WHEN a payment becomes SUCCESSFUL THE SYSTEM SHALL move every CONFIRMED service of the order items it covers to READY TO PROCEED and remove their payment time limits. (Lean: `applyOutcome`)

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a payment is SUCCESSFUL THE SYSTEM SHALL move every CONFIRMED service of the order items it covers to READY TO PROCEED.
   - ONE-305.1, proven: proven theorem `applyOutcome_ready`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined`
2. WHEN a payment is SUCCESSFUL THE SYSTEM SHALL remove the payment time limits of the order items it covers.
   - ONE-305.2, proven: proven theorem `applyOutcome_no_time_limit`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined`
3. IF a payment is FAILED THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the services and payment time limits of the order items it covers unchanged.
   - ONE-305.3, proven: proven theorem `applyOutcome_unsuccessful`; example `declinedCardForBag`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined`
4. WHILE a payment is PENDING THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the services and payment time limits of the order items it covers unchanged.
   - ONE-305.4, proven: proven theorem `applyOutcome_unsuccessful`; example `pendingRedirect`
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the order items a payment does not cover unchanged.
   - ONE-305.5, proven: proven theorem `applyOutcome_uncovered`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined`
